company.shortDescription: Marketplace for couples, friends, and families to discover, book, and organize private group activities.
company.description:
Outing is a b2b2c marketplace that makes it easy for couples, friends, and families to book private group activities.

Our product allows anyone to book popular activities like kayaking, pottery, sailing, paintballing, and even unique hard to organize ones like improv sessions, segway polo, multiplayer vr, and more with the people they know in just a few taps.

There is over $300B spend on recreation, and locals spend as much as $54B on private group activities but it’s still highly fragmented and many of the activity providers are mom and pop shops with outdated tech and processes.
